niche: a family-owned timber company's 2027 salvage marking decided on each stand's 2021 to 2026 mortality in its permanent inventory plots, where the 2024 underburns loosened tags and the 2026 contract crew tallied the untagged survivors again as new trees
analyst_test: A strong analyst who conforms the company database's 2021 cycle and the contract crews' 2026 export (company against FIA species codes, padded against integer keys, conditions through the plot register), joins them by plot and tag, counts every 2021 live tree without a live 2026 record under its tag as lost under Policy 7.4 and marks eight stands: CF-104, CF-118, CF-129, CF-144 and CF-160 with CF-112, CF-138 and CF-152.
domain_test: General statistics, so the swap is of the method: the deciding quantity is an entity-resolution estimate, each 2021 tree's fate resolved across two inventories whose identifier failed for part of the population, linked by plot position, species and a size no newcomer could reach; replacing it with the identifier join or with dropping the unmatched trees files a different set of stands.

plots mapped into two conditions since 2021, the register giving each condition's stand and share and each tree record its condition id
heights blank for the plots measured in the smoke week of July 20 to 24, returned in a separate September file
cut records from the 2023 road clearing and the 2012 thinning, earlier deaths in the 2006 to 2016 history, gaps in the company's tag series
trees the 2021 crew passed over, tallied for the first time in 2026
found tags entered beside an added tag for one tree (the asks' device)

spine.entity: one tree's measurement in one inventory cycle (tree_meas, cycles 2006 to 2021)

world.geography: United States (a fictional tree farm in California's northern Sierra Nevada)
world.org_type: family-owned timber company with a sawmill and its own timberland

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a cohort lost between two inventories, where some members' identifiers were destroyed between them and the second inventory recorded those members again as newcomers under new identifiers; an identifier join counts each such member both lost and new, and only its position, kind and a size no newcomer could reach link it back.
driver_concrete: Each stand's 2021 to 2026 loss is the basal area of trees tallied live in 2021 that are not tallied live in 2026; on the plots underburned in 2024 bole char took about a third of the large survivors' tags, and the 2026 contract crews coded each untagged tree's old number not found and tallied the tree again as added under a new tag; the tag join counts those trees lost and marks eight stands, the stem map links them back and marks three.
stump: The default path joins the 2021 and 2026 tallies by plot and tag, counts every 2021 live tree without a live 2026 record under its tag as lost, and marks eight stands (CF-104, CF-118, CF-129, CF-144 and CF-160 at 21.5 to 27.2 per cent with CF-112, CF-138 and CF-152), because it never asks whether the added trees of 9 inches and more standing where a tree was not found are those trees tagged again; placed on the 2021 stem map they are, and three stands are marked.

differentiation.task482: task482's twelfth architecture recovers people present from the load a shared physical system carries where no stay record exists; this build re-links each tree whose identifier failed to its earlier record by its position, species and a size no newcomer could reach, so the same members are not counted lost and new

lineage.fate: spent at stage 4, 2026-10-20: judge SEND_BACK (Gate H rule_application) and both scored readers landed the call; the block-group rebuild was exact arithmetic once the area was filed
lineage.driver: A rate for an earlier period is needed for units drawn only later, and the units they were split from published it only as a whole, while finer units that tile the later units published it too; spreading the parent's rate to its parts makes the part holding the parent's high-rate pieces look like it rose and hides a rise in the other, so the earlier rate is rebuilt from the finer units and its error combined from theirs before the change is tested.
lineage.stump: The default path conforms the 2014 to 2018 tract estimates to 2020 tracts through the relationship file, gives each split tract's children their parent's poverty rate and margin of error, and designates Dunmore Heights and Linden Row, because the child holding a parent's poor block groups shows a significant rise that is only the split; rebuilding each child's earlier rate from its own 2010 block groups designates Dunmore Heights and Kestrel Park.

lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-01 at the re-check's stage 4: judge pass 4 NOT_DETERMINISTIC, SEND_BACK (Gate C/E underspecified_objective): guidelines 2.2 file a start only for called leaks, so a surveyed leak's start (find, previous survey, midpoint, seasonal expectation) designates 0, 12, 3 or 5 districts and nothing filed rules out the midpoint; the sentence that would close the fork names the decisive step, so the fork is the stump; the shipped pack stays at the portal, pending, untouched (target.zip 5a46ee5a)
lineage.driver: Each item is found only at a periodic inspection made at a fixed point in the year for each unit, after having begun at an unrecorded time since the previous inspection, and items begin mostly in one season, so the time each was active before it was found depends on when in the year its unit is inspected; the even-spread assumption misprices units inspected long after the season, and the seasonal profile comes from a second record whose items are reported as soon as they begin.
lineage.stump: The default path counts each 2026 leak's methane from the day it was found to its repair, and the textbook correction starts each surveyed leak halfway back to the previous survey; both designate the wrong districts, because leaks begin mostly in the frost months, so the districts surveyed in late autumn found leaks that had emitted since winter; estimating each leak's start from the monthly profile of the odor-report leaks designates the districts the program should fund.
lineage.niche: a city-owned gas utility's leak-based methane inventory by district for its accelerated cast-iron and bare-steel main replacement program, leaks found at once-a-year district surveys in each district's own month

lineage.fate: abandoned at the 2026-11-04 stage-4 re-judge (pass 2 NOT_DETERMINISTIC, competing_defensible_answer): Gate C on the main call, the record unable to separate each pump test's constant kWh per acre-foot from the head-adjusted conversion, with Gates G and H passing, so not spent by the gate table; re-drawn rather than repaired because separating the two needed a new data organ, a metered deep well, inside a 24 acre-foot decision margin
lineage.niche: a San Joaquin Valley farming company's water year 2026 groundwater extraction return to its subbasin's groundwater sustainability agency, integrated from the electric utility's interval data, the wells' pump efficiency tests, their water level transducers and the upper-aquifer wells' totalizer meters, and the transfer water it must buy before the agency's true-up
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is a volume read through a metered input whose yield per unit of input is set by a physical state the meter does not see, measured once at one setting of that state; the state moves through the period and another system records it interval by interval, so the period's volume is each interval's input converted at its own state, and the single test's yield files the volume as if the state had stayed where the test found it.
lineage.stump: The default path converts each unmetered well's 2026 kilowatt-hours at its pump test's kilowatt-hours per acre-foot, which the metered upper-aquifer wells confirm within 1.5 per cent, and files no transfer to buy, because it never asks what head each interval's power lifted water against: the deep wells were tested near the confined aquifer's late-summer low and pumped their March to May water 40 to 110 feet higher.

notes: stump_strategy identity_resolution: the decisive step resolves each 2021 tree's identity in the 2026 tally where its tag failed, by position, species and growth, which no column flags.
